title: Die wissenschaftliche Realität zeitübergreifender Quantenkorrelationen und ihre informatische Skalierung
author: Ingolf Lohmann

claims.statement: Delayed-choice quantum eraser experiments report delayed determination of particlelike or wavelike behavior through entanglement and later-conditioned coincidence subsets.
claims.boundary: The original apparatus uses passive optics and random detector outcomes; it does not establish a freely controllable later sender bit or a classical message in the earlier unsorted marginal.

claims.statement: For a bipartite quantum state and a complete local POVM on the later subsystem, summing over later outcomes leaves the earlier local marginal independent of the later measurement setting.
claims.boundary: Conditional and joint distributions may still depend on the later setting and outcome.

claims.statement: Delayed-choice entanglement swapping has experimentally projected already registered photons into entangled or separable correlated subensembles.
claims.boundary: The authors' steering-into-the-past language does not itself prove controllable backward signalling.

claims.statement: Entanglement has been demonstrated between photons that never coexisted, including a photon detected before the other photon was created.
claims.boundary: Timelike entanglement is not equivalent to a classical message channel into the past.

claims.statement: A delayed-choice quantum eraser has been implemented with entangled surface acoustic phonons in a superconducting system.
claims.boundary: Conditional recovery of interference is distinct from backward communication capacity.

claims.statement: Time-symmetric and retrocausal formulations are established research model classes in quantum foundations.
claims.boundary: Scientific legitimacy of a model class does not establish uniqueness or empirical confirmation of one ontology.

claims.statement: QIK-VRT separates host-causal order, virtual order, local event time and evidential order.
claims.source: Relationale Zeit, virtuelle Retrokausalität und die monoton wachsende Evidenzkugel, Section 4
claims.boundary: These model coordinates are not automatically physical proper time or spacetime coordinates.

claims.statement: Under an irreflexive transitive host order and send-before-deliver axiom, no delivery can be a host-cause of its own send event.
claims.source: Relationale Zeit, virtuelle Retrokausalität und die monoton wachsende Evidenzkugel, Theorem 4.9
claims.boundary: This theorem protects the host boundary and does not deny virtual or semantic retrograde order.

claims.statement: A complete immutable receipt that includes predecessor, input and successor uniquely reconstructs the predecessor even when the transition function is not injective.
claims.source: Relationale Zeit, virtuelle Retrokausalität und die monoton wachsende Evidenzkugel, Theorem 5.4
claims.boundary: Reconstruction uses stored provenance; it does not physically rewrite the past.

claims.statement: A fully logged finite trace can be replayed in reverse label order while every physical read remains later than the writes on which it depends.
claims.source: Relationale Zeit, virtuelle Retrokausalität und die monoton wachsende Evidenzkugel, Theorem 5.5
claims.boundary: Reverse replay is not a host-time reversal.

claims.statement: Large data corpora can be future-indexed, later conditioned and provenance-bound for reverse reconstruction in a physically forward-running system.
claims.source: Goldkelch/qik-vrt exact repository artifacts and receipts
claims.boundary: Concrete scale, throughput and energy claims require exact-head benchmarks.

claims.statement: The structural correspondence between delayed-choice conditioning and later classification of immutable earlier data is algorithmically realizable.
claims.boundary: Algorithmic correspondence is not a second physical photon experiment.

claims.statement: A temporal communication service requires a pre-bound temporal address, codebook, authentication, decoding, error and reobservation contract before the later message choice.
claims.boundary: Such infrastructure is necessary for identifiable messaging but does not create a physical carrier.

claims.statement: An operational future-to-past channel requires interventionally different earlier bound marginal distributions for independently randomized later settings, a preregistered decoder without later-outcome postselection, and positive independently replicated channel capacity.
claims.boundary: The criterion is specified; a positive natural-channel result is not reported here.

claims.statement: No positive independently replicated natural future-to-past channel capacity is established by the present manuscript.
claims.boundary: Requires preregistered multi-laboratory intervention and leakage controls.

claims.statement: The QIK-VRT Effect Acknowledgement Internet-Draft publicly specifies a five-state application-layer control record that separates receipt from downstream effect authorization.
claims.boundary: Active individual Internet-Draft; not an RFC or IETF consensus, and it does not prove physical retrocausality.

claims.statement: Ingolf Lohmann is the conceptual originator of the relation-first, TEMDD, event-time, proof-ring, evidence-sphere and virtual-retrocausality combination documented in the source preprint.
claims.source: Relationale Zeit, virtuelle Retrokausalität und die monoton wachsende Evidenzkugel, Section 1.2
claims.boundary: Attribution within the cited work is distinct from independent priority adjudication by the scientific community.

claims.statement: A standalone Wikipedia article about QIK-VRT or this contribution requires substantial independent secondary-source coverage and conflict-of-interest-safe community review.
claims.source: Wikipedia no-original-research, notability and conflict-of-interest policies
claims.boundary: Primary sources and self-authored deposits are insufficient for an encyclopedic article.
